parts.t: Cloverdale BC is the MLS® area around Cloverdale’s historic town centre, where Highway 10 (56 Avenue) meets Highway 15 (Pacific Highway). The City calls downtown Cloverdale the historical centre of Surrey. You will find older houses near the town centre, newer subdivisions and townhomes, and farmland at the edges, with a new hospital being built.

Written by Jared Gibbons, REALTOR®, Royal LePage Little Oak Realty, on October 13, 2026. I have worked in Fraser Valley real estate since 2015. Rules and boundaries change, so confirm anything important with the City of Surrey and Surrey Schools.
Not legal, planning or financial advice. Confirm zoning, plan designations and school catchments before you buy or sell.

The Town Centre Plan is being updated. Zoning and plan designations can be different for each lot.
The 2019 Cloverdale Town Centre Plan guides growth over 30 years, around a downtown core with commercial, industrial and residential areas.
On July 22, 2024, Council added roughly 80.8 hectares and 145 properties to the plan area: the land between 60 and 64 Avenue and 175 to 180 Street, plus one lot at 18120 56 Avenue.
The update is meant to plan for the new hospital and BC Cancer Centre. Check the City page for its current status.
Some homes are listed City heritage sites. Ask whether a property has heritage status before you plan changes.
